summary: Boise Cascade Company filed an 8-K on August 3, 2026, reporting Q2 2026 financial results (Item 2.02) and disclosing a new distribution agreement (Item 8.01). Its subsidiary entered a 10-year exclusive full-line national distribution agreement with James Hardie for exterior building products. The filing also includes incentives for transitioning from competing product lines. This is a routine operational update and business contract, not a special-situation corporate event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or strategic review. There are no deal terms, premiums, or structural changes affecting shareholders. The agreement may affect future revenues but does not constitute a fundamental corporate action requiring special-situations classification.
